structure.source: NIST CCCBDB experimental geometry, reference Gurvich (r O–H 0.960 Å, r O–F 1.442 Å, angle H–O–F 97.2°)

notes.title: Construction without symmetry
notes.text: With no symmetry group to pair atoms, the construction slider switches on every coupling to oxygen in one step.

notes.title: Inequivalent terminal atoms
notes.text: H and F are different, so fix-and-flip pairing does not apply: there is no equal-energy pair to combine.
